title: metadata-protocol: a tenant edit served at its item's new owner after a suite move is listed under neither package by the customizations read, and the item lock does not see it
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKZzp4DLtqiCkZZRM

Filing gate: ② a follow-up the seat's ACCEPT of PR #31653 (#31593) names, from the dev's open question 3. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:server` (metadata-protocol). Files: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-served-overrides.ts` (`listServedOverrides`), the item-lock resolution in `item-lock.ts`, and the predicates #31593 adds in `suite-moved-overlay.ts`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `listServedOverrides` → #31593 only.
reach: every tenant with an edit of an item that a later App version moved to another package of the same App (ADR-0130 D4 suite splits and their rollbacks), the case #31593 serves.
class: b · type: Bug
Grade: left to triage (seat suggests p2: same release as #31593, read-only).

## 维护者速读

#31593（PR #31653）之后，套件拆分把条目挪到同一 App 的另一个包时，租户的修改会在新包下照常生效。但"该包的定制列表"（`GET /packages/:id/customizations`）仍按修改时声明的旧包来列，所以这条修改在新旧两个包下都列不出来，直到再保存一次；条目锁的判定也没读同一套规则。让列表和锁读 #31593 的同一组判定。

## What is wrong (read in the tree at the seat's ACCEPT, not measured)

- After #31593, the served reads (by name, `?package=`, list, layered `effective`) serve a moved edit at the package that ships the item now, through `isMovedOverrideRowOf` / `isMovedBaseRowOf`.
- `listServedOverrides` still lists a pair override under the package its declaration names. The old owner no longer ships the item and the new owner's listing does not read the moved predicates, so the served edit is listed under neither until it is saved again.
- The item lock resolution does not read the moved predicates either.

## Expected

- The customizations read and the item lock read the same predicates as the served reads, so a moved edit is listed (and locked) under the package that serves it, and only there.
- Pins red on main first: after a flat → composed move, the new owner's customizations list holds the edit; CONTROL: an edit whose owner still ships the item is listed as today; a row of another App never appears.

Related: #31593 / PR #31653, ADR-0146 D2/D3, ADR-0130 D4.
